steps.title: Prepare required buffers
steps.instruction:
Make all buffers listed in the Recipes section using the specified reagents and volumes: 
- NE1 buffer: 1 ml 1 M HEPES‑KOH pH 7.9, 0.5 ml 1 M KCl, 12.5 µl 2 M spermidine, 0.5 ml 10 % Triton X‑100, 10 ml glycerol, bring to 38 ml with dH₂O, add 1 Roche Complete Protease Inhibitor tablet. 
- Wash buffer: 1 ml 1 M HEPES pH 7.5, 1.5 ml 5 M NaCl, 12.5 µl 2 M spermidine, bring to 50 ml with dH₂O, add 1 protease inhibitor tablet. 
- Binding buffer: 200 µl 1 M HEPES‑KOH pH 7.9, 100 µl 1 M KCl, 10 µl 1 M CaCl₂, 10 µl 1 M MnCl₂, bring to 10 ml with dH₂O. 
- Antibody buffer: 5 µl 200× BSA + 1 ml Wash buffer, keep on ice. 
- 300‑wash buffer: 1 ml 1 M HEPES pH 7.5, 3 ml 5 M NaCl, 12.5 µl 2 M spermidine, bring to 50 ml with dH₂O, add 1 protease inhibitor tablet. 
- CUT&Tag Tagmentation buffer: 1 ml 300‑wash buffer + 10 µl 1 M MgCl₂ (final 10 mM MgCl₂). 
- CUTAC‑tag buffer: 197 µl dH₂O, 2 µl 1 M TAPS pH 8.5, 1 µl 1 M MgCl₂ (final 10 mM TAPS, 5 mM MgCl₂). 
- CUTAC‑hex buffer: 97 µl dH₂O, 100 µl 20 % 1,6‑hexanediol, 2 µl 1 M TAPS pH 8.5, 1 µl 1 M MgCl₂ (final 10 mM TAPS, 5 mM MgCl₂, 10 % 1,6‑hexanediol). 
- TAPS wash buffer: 1 ml dH₂O, 10 µl 1 M TAPS pH 8.5, 0.4 µl 0.5 M EDTA (final 10 mM TAPS, 0.2 mM EDTA). 
- 0.1 % SDS release solution: 10 µl 10 % SDS + 10 µl 1 M TAPS pH 8.5 in 1 ml dH₂O. 
- 0.67 % Triton neutralization solution: 67 µl 10 % Triton‑X‑100 + 933 µl dH₂O.

steps.title: Harvest cells and isolate nuclei
steps.instruction: Harvest fresh K562 (or other) culture in a 15 ml or 50 ml conical tube at room temperature, count cells, centrifuge 3 min at 600 × g (swinging‑bucket, RT) and discard supernatant. Resuspend in 1 × culture volume of PBS (RT) by pipetting, centrifuge again 3 min at 600 × g (RT) and discard supernatant. Resuspend pellet in 0.5 × culture volume of ice‑cold NE1 buffer, vortex gently, incubate on ice 10 min. Centrifuge 4 min at 1 300 × g, 4 °C, pour off liquid onto paper towel briefly. Resuspend in 0.5 × culture volume of PBS. For fixation, add 16 % formaldehyde to a final 0.1 % (e.g., 62 µl to 10 ml) while vortexing gently, incubate RT 2 min. Quench with 1.25 M glycine to twice the molar amount of formaldehyde (e.g., 600 µl to 10 ml), mix, centrifuge 4 min at 1 300 × g, 4 °C, discard supernatant. Resuspend nuclei in Wash buffer to ~1 × 10⁶ cells ml⁻¹, verify count with ViCell or slide. Optional cryopreservation: aliquot 900 µl nuclei + 100 µl DMSO into cryovials, mix, place in Mr. Frosty with isopropanol, freeze at –80 °C overnight, store long‑term at –80 °C.

steps.title: Prepare ConA‑coated magnetic beads
steps.instruction: Withdraw enough ConA bead slurry to provide 3.5 µl beads per sample (≈50 000 cells → ≥50 % nuclei yield). Transfer to a 1 ml of Binding buffer in a 1.5 ml tube (up to 60 µl beads for 16 samples, 120 µl for 32 samples). Mix by pipetting, place on magnet (~1 min) and discard supernatant. Add 1 ml Binding buffer, mix, magnet, discard supernatant, repeat once more, then resuspend the bead pellet in 60 µl Binding buffer (final bead concentration 3.5 µl per future sample).

steps.title: Bind nuclei to ConA beads
steps.instruction: Thaw frozen nuclei aliquot at RT (e.g., in a 20 ml beaker of water). Transfer ≤50 000 nuclei (in Wash buffer) to each low‑retention 0.5 ml PCR tube, add 3.5 µl prepared ConA beads, and rotate at RT for 10 min. Place tubes on magnet, let beads collect, and carefully remove supernatant without aspirating beads (set pipette 5 µl less than total volume, use a second draw with a 20 µl tip if needed).

steps.title: Incubate primary antibody
steps.instruction: Dilute the primary antibody 1:50–1:100 in Antibody buffer. Resuspend each bead‑bound sample in 25 µl of this diluted antibody, vortex gently, and rotate at RT for 1–2 h (or overnight at 4 °C).

steps.title: Incubate secondary antibody
steps.instruction: Place tubes on magnet, discard supernatant. Prepare secondary antibody at 1:100 in Wash buffer. Add 25 µl per sample, vortex to dislodge beads, and rotate at RT for 0.5–1 h. Perform a quick spin (<500 × g) to collect liquid, place tubes on magnet, and discard supernatant with two successive 20 µl draws. Add 500 µl Wash buffer, let beads slide up, then withdraw 470 µl with a 1 ml tip without disturbing beads. Quick spin, return to magnet, and repeat the 470 µl removal with a 20 µl pipettor until all liquid is gone. Proceed immediately to the next step.

steps.title: Add pA‑Tn5 adapter complex
steps.instruction: Prepare pA‑Tn5 pre‑loaded adapter mix in 300‑wash buffer according to the manufacturer’s instructions. Add 25 µl of this mix to each sample, vortex, and rotate at RT for 1–2 h. Quick spin, place on magnet, and remove supernatant with a 20 µl pipettor (two draws). Add 500 µl 300‑wash buffer, withdraw 470 µl as described in the secondary‑antibody wash, quick spin, magnet, and discard remaining supernatant with multiple 20 µl draws. Proceed immediately to tagmentation.

steps.title: Tagmentation and release
steps.instruction:
Resuspend bead‑nuclei pellet in 50 µl of the appropriate tagmentation buffer: 
- For CUT&Tag: CUT&Tag Tagmentation buffer (10 mM MgCl₂ in 300‑wash buffer). 
- For CUTAC: either CUTAC‑tag buffer or CUTAC‑hex buffer (contains 10 % 1,6‑hexanediol or DMF). Vortex or rotate to dislodge beads. Quick spin, then incubate in a PCR cycler at 37 °C for 1 h (CUTAC 20 min) with heated lid, then hold at 8 °C. Place on magnet, discard supernatant with a 20 µl pipettor (multiple draws). Resuspend beads in 50 µl TAPS wash buffer, invert, quick spin, magnet, discard supernatant as before. Resuspend beads in 5 µl 0.1 % SDS release solution, wet tube sides with the tip, quick spin, and incubate at 58 °C for 1 h (heated lid) to release pA‑Tn5‑tagmented DNA.

steps.title: PCR amplification of libraries
steps.instruction:
To each tube (still containing beads), add 15 µl 0.1 % SDS release solution (already present) plus 2 µl 10 µM universal i5 primer and 2 µl 10 µM uniquely barcoded i7 primer (different barcode per sample). Vortex vigorously, place on ice. Add 25 µl NEBNext 2× PCR Master Mix (non‑hot‑start), vortex, quick spin, and immediately load into a thermocycler. Run the following program (heated lid):
1) 58 °C 5 min (gap fill) 
2) 72 °C 5 min (gap fill) 
3) 98 °C 30 s 
4) 98 °C 10 s 
5) 60 °C 10 s 
Repeat steps 4–5 for 11 cycles 
Final extension: 72 °C 1 min, hold 8 °C. (Do not exceed 12–14 total cycles; for cross‑linked samples step 3 may be extended to 5 min).

steps.title: Post‑PCR SPRI bead cleanup
steps.instruction: Add 65 µl SPRI beads to each PCR reaction (1.3 × volume). Mix by pipetting, incubate RT 5–10 min. Place on magnetic stand until clear, discard supernatant. With tubes still on magnet, add 200 µl 80 % ethanol, let stand briefly, then remove ethanol. Repeat ethanol wash once more. Quick spin, remove residual ethanol with a 20 µl pipettor, avoiding bead drying. Remove tubes from magnet, add 22 µl 10 mM Tris‑HCl pH 8.0, vortex, incubate 5 min–1 h at RT. Place on magnet, let clear, and transfer the eluate to a new 1.5 ml tube, avoiding beads.

steps.title: Library QC and sequencing
steps.instruction: Analyze library size distribution and concentration on an Agilent TapeStation (D1000) or equivalent. Dilute each library to 2 nM based on fragment molarity in the 175–1000 bp range. Pool barcoded libraries in equimolar amounts to the final concentration recommended by the sequencer. If residual primers are present, perform an additional SPRI cleanup. Sequence pooled libraries on an Illumina platform using paired‑end reads (PE25 is sufficient); a HiSeq 2‑lane rapid run yields ~300 M mapped reads (~3 M per sample when 96 samples are pooled).
